title: Implement the pure catalogue text parser
acceptance_criteria: The parser accepts plain catalogue text and has no DOM, filesystem, or browser-storage dependency.
The parser emits one raw structured record per documented exercise boundary and preserves all required prose fields.
The parser normalizes documented list fields into arrays and common errors into error/correction pairs without dropping non-empty values.
The parser ignores report-level sections and rejects a record missing any required field with an actionable error.
The parser exposes typed output suitable for a separate conversion step and does not mutate its input text.
completion_summary: Implemented pure typed catalogue parser with normalization, ordered-field validation, arrays, numbered steps, error pairs, report exclusions, and actionable errors. Build command was blocked by environment permissions.
